description: Generate a textured 3D model from a text prompt as a GLB file, saved as a new model asset in the user's Voidless library. For a model the user already has use upload_3d_model; for a 2D sprite use generate_image. 45 credits for mode 'game' or 15 for an 'lq' draft, charged on every call and refunded if it fails; a slow run returns a job for check_generation. Returns the asset ID, the GLB link, a thumbnail and the seed; a character goes on to rig_3d_model, then animate_3d_model and render_3d_sprites.

bodyType.description: type 'character' only: the body plan (default humanoid). Ignored for objects

mode.description: game = game-ready, a light clean mesh of about 19k triangles (45 credits); lq = draft (15 credits). hq is an old name for game

prompt.description: The single model to make, with its shape, materials and colours, e.g. 'wooden treasure chest with iron bands'

seed.description: RNG seed (0 = random, the default). The result reports the seed used

style.description: 'low-poly' (default: faceted triangles, flat colours), 'blocky' (voxel art, built from cubes), 'claymation', 'origami', 'hand-painted' (stylized fantasy) or 'toy' (glossy vinyl figure)

type.description: 'character' makes a T-posed figure ready for rigging

name: generate_3d_model
